implementation.rationale: default executor for bounded implementation work

review.rationale: cost-efficient independent gate for GREEN tasks; elevated by task class when needed

fix.rationale: targeted correction after findings narrow the scope

rereview.rationale: cost-efficient narrow gate for GREEN tasks; elevated by task class when needed

diagnosis.rationale: read-only root-cause and contract resolution for RED or dynamically escalated tasks

diagnosis_escalated.rationale: exception-only read-only escalation when medium diagnosis remains unresolved

acceptance.rationale: acceptance is provenance recording after an independent ACCEPT, so no LLM reasoning is required
